html:
The traditional date when the Mexica, the people later called Aztecs, founded Tenochtitlan on a small island in Lake Texcoco, in the Valley of Mexico. Some sources give 1345 instead.

The Mexica said they had wandered for generations from a homeland called Aztlan. Their god Huitzilopochtli told them to settle where they saw an eagle on a cactus eating a snake. That sign is on Mexico's flag today.

At first the Mexica were poor latecomers who paid tribute to the town of Azcapotzalco. They built up their island with chinampas and causeways. In 1428 they joined Texcoco and Tlacopan in the Triple Alliance and began to build an empire.

By 1519 Tenochtitlan was one of the largest cities in the world, with the Templo Mayor at its heart. After the fall of the city in 1521, the Spanish built Mexico City on its ruins.
sum: The traditional date when the Mexica, the people later called Aztecs, founded Tenochtitlan on a small island in Lake Texcoco, in the Valley of Mexico. Some sources give 1345 instead.
